June 26, 2018 - By Russell Anderson

Evanson Asset Management Llc bought 22,446 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.31% with the market. The institutional investor held 48,886 shares of the business services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.50M, up from 26,440 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Evanson Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Accenture Plc Ireland for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $100.61 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.18% or $0.28 during the last trading session, reaching $156.44. About 403,310 shares traded. Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) has risen 26.72% since June 26, 2017 and is uptrending.
